signature.name: VTask.comp
signature.type: {R : Type u_1} -> {A : Type u_2} -> {B : Type u_3} -> {C : Type u_4} -> [Monoid R] -> [NonUnitalNonAssocSemiring A] -> [DistribMulAction R A] -> [Star A] -> [NonUnitalNonAssocSemiring B] -> [DistribMulAction R B] -> [Star B] -> [NonUnitalNonAssocSemiring C] -> [DistribMulAction R C] -> [Star C] -> (f : B →⋆ₙₐ[R] C) -> (g : A →⋆ₙₐ[R] B) -> A →⋆ₙₐ[R] C

conventions.note: NONE_DECLARED: VTask.comp is a total construction; every pair of composable non-unital ⋆-algebra homomorphisms yields a well-formed result with no junk-value or boundary conventions needed.

facts.statement: ∀ {R A B C : Type*} [Monoid R] [NonUnitalNonAssocSemiring A] [DistribMulAction R A] [Star A] [NonUnitalNonAssocSemiring B] [DistribMulAction R B] [Star B] [NonUnitalNonAssocSemiring C] [DistribMulAction R C] [Star C] (f : B →⋆ₙₐ[R] C) (g : A →⋆ₙₐ[R] B) (a b : A), VTask.comp f g (a * b) = (VTask.comp f g a) * (VTask.comp f g b)

facts.statement: ∀ {R A B C : Type*} [Monoid R] [NonUnitalNonAssocSemiring A] [DistribMulAction R A] [Star A] [NonUnitalNonAssocSemiring B] [DistribMulAction R B] [Star B] [NonUnitalNonAssocSemiring C] [DistribMulAction R C] [Star C] (f : B →⋆ₙₐ[R] C) (g : A →⋆ₙₐ[R] B) (a b : A), VTask.comp f g (a + b) = (VTask.comp f g a) + (VTask.comp f g b)

facts.statement: ∀ {R A B C : Type*} [Monoid R] [NonUnitalNonAssocSemiring A] [DistribMulAction R A] [Star A] [NonUnitalNonAssocSemiring B] [DistribMulAction R B] [Star B] [NonUnitalNonAssocSemiring C] [DistribMulAction R C] [Star C] (f : B →⋆ₙₐ[R] C) (g : A →⋆ₙₐ[R] B) (r : R) (a : A), VTask.comp f g (r • a) = r • (VTask.comp f g a)
